name: @ai-fleet/shared-core
description: Lightweight AI Fleet primitives with NO LLM / agent-SDK dependencies: config, egress routes, logger, authz, OAuth token plumbing, Pub/Sub messaging, and the runtime provisioner. Imported by the non-agent services (proxy, provisioner) so they never pull in the ~600 MB agent-SDK tree. The heavy @ai-fleet/shared depends on this package and re-exports these paths (thin shims) for backward compatibility.
